There are many voices, many dialects and accents, many ways of saying and telling things, many ways of speaking out and expressing oneself. There are many ways of singing and of making noises. The voices of those who have been gleaned and collected from a thousand, a million places, a thousand different worlds. Many different worlds, many different peoples, many different creatures.
